1.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

2.english_reference: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י ךָ אֶל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis pone fáciem tuam ad montes Israel ,
traditions.KJV: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֲלֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et prophetábis ad eos ,
traditions.KJV: and prophesy against them ,

3.english_reference: And say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς Τὰ ὄρη Ἰσραήλ , ἀκούσατε λόγον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et dices : Montes Israel audíte verbum Dómini Dei :
traditions.KJV: And say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord GOD ;

3.english_reference: Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְ֠הוִה לֶ הָרִ֨ים
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus móntibus ,
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains ,

3.english_reference: and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys ;

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ גְּבָע֜וֹת לָ אֲפִיקִ֣ים ו ל גאית
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς καὶ ταῖς φάραγξιν καὶ ταῖς νάπαις
traditions.VUL: et cóllibus , rúpibus , et vállibus :
traditions.KJV: and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys ;

3.english_reference: Behold , I , [ even ] I , will bring a sword upon you ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵי כֶם֙ חֶ֔רֶב
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego indúcam super vos gládium ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I , [ even ] I , will bring a sword upon you ,

3.english_reference: and I will destroy your high places .

traditions.WLC: וְ אִבַּדְתִּ֖י בָּמֽוֹתֵי כֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et dispérdam excélsa vestra ,
traditions.KJV: and I will destroy your high places .

4.english_reference: And your altars shall be desolate ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ מִזְבְּח֣וֹתֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et demóliar aras vestras ,
traditions.KJV: And your altars shall be desolate ,

4.english_reference: and your images shall be broken :

traditions.WLC: וְ נִשְׁבְּר֖וּ חַמָּֽנֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.VUL: et confringéntur simulácra vestra :
traditions.KJV: and your images shall be broken :

4.english_reference: and I will cast down your slain [ men ] before your idols .

traditions.WLC: וְ הִפַּלְתִּי֙ חַלְלֵי כֶ֔ם לִ פְנֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταβαλῶ τραυματίας ὑμῶν ἐνώπιον τῶν εἰδώλων ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et deíciam interféctos vestros ante idóla vestra .
traditions.KJV: and I will cast down your slain [ men ] before your idols .

5.english_reference: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols ;

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֗י אֶת פִּגְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ פְנֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.VUL: Et dabo cadávera filiórum Israel ante fáciem simulacrórum vestrórum :
traditions.KJV: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols ;

5.english_reference: and I will scatter your bones round about your altars .

traditions.WLC: וְ זֵרִיתִי֙ אֶת עַצְמ֣וֹתֵי כֶ֔ם סְבִיב֖וֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασκορπιῶ τὰ ὀστᾶ ὑμῶν κύκλῳ τῶν θυσιαστηρίων ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: et dispérgam ossa vestra circum aras vestras
traditions.KJV: and I will scatter your bones round about your altars .

6.english_reference: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ כֹל֙ מוֹשְׁב֣וֹתֵי כֶ֔ם הֶ עָרִ֣ים תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה
traditions.LXX: ἐν πάσῃ τῇ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν αἱ πόλεις ἐξερημωθήσονται
traditions.VUL: in ómnibus habitatiónibus vestris . Urbes desértæ erunt ,
traditions.KJV: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste ,

6.english_reference: and the high places shall be desolate ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ בָּמ֖וֹת תִּישָׁ֑מְנָה
traditions.VUL: et excélsa demoliéntur , et dissipabúntur :
traditions.KJV: and the high places shall be desolate ;

6.english_reference: that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate ,

traditions.WLC: לְמַעַן֩ יֶחֶרְב֨וּ וְ יֶאְשְׁמ֜וּ מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵי כֶ֗ם
traditions.VUL: et interíbunt aræ vestræ , et confringéntur :
traditions.KJV: that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate ,

6.english_reference: and your idols may be broken and cease ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נִשְׁבְּר֤וּ וְ נִשְׁבְּתוּ֙ גִּלּ֣וּלֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et cessábunt idóla vestra ,
traditions.KJV: and your idols may be broken and cease ,

6.english_reference: and your images may be cut down ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נִגְדְּעוּ֙ חַמָּ֣נֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et conteréntur delúbra vestra ,
traditions.KJV: and your images may be cut down ,

6.english_reference: and your works may be abolished .

traditions.WLC: וְ נִמְח֖וּ מַעֲשֵׂי כֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et delebúntur ópera vestra .
traditions.KJV: and your works may be abolished .

7.english_reference: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָפַ֥ל חָלָ֖ל בְּ תֽוֹכְ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεσοῦνται τραυματίαι ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Et cadet interféctus in médio vestri ,
traditions.KJV: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you ,

7.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego sum Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

8.english_reference: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have [ some ] that shall escape the sword among the nations ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הוֹתַרְתִּ֗י בִּ הְי֥וֹת לָ כֶ֛ם פְּלִ֥יטֵי חֶ֖רֶב בַּ גּוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ γενέσθαι ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀνασωζομένους ἐκ ῥομφαίας ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Et relínquam in vobis eos , qui fúgerint gládium in géntibus ,
traditions.KJV: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have [ some ] that shall escape the sword among the nations ,

8.english_reference: when ye shall be scattered through the countries .

traditions.WLC: בְּ הִזָּרֽוֹתֵי כֶ֖ם בָּ אֲרָצֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ διασκορπισμῷ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς χώραις ,
traditions.VUL: cum dispérsero vos in terris .
traditions.KJV: when ye shall be scattered through the countries .

9.english_reference: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives ,

traditions.WLC: וְ זָכְר֨וּ פְלִֽיטֵי כֶ֜ם אוֹתִ֗ י בַּ גּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ שָׁם֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ μνησθήσονταί μου οἱ ἀνασωζόμενοι ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὗ ᾐχμαλωτεύθησαν ἐκεῖ ·
traditions.VUL: Et recordabúntur mei liberáti vestri in géntibus , ad quas captívi ducti sunt :
traditions.KJV: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives ,

9.english_reference: because I am broken with their whorish heart , which hath departed from me ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֜רְתִּי אֶת לִבָּ֣ ם הַ זּוֹנֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר סָר֙ מֵֽ עָלַ֔ י
traditions.LXX: ὀμώμοκα τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν τῇ ἐκπορνευούσῃ ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ
traditions.VUL: quia contrívi cor eórum fórnicans , et recédens a me ,
traditions.KJV: because I am broken with their whorish heart , which hath departed from me ,

9.english_reference: and with their eyes , which go a whoring after their idols :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ עֵֽינֵי הֶ֔ם הַ זֹּנ֕וֹת אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν τοῖς πορνεύουσιν ὀπίσω τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et óculos eórum fornicántes post idóla sua :
traditions.KJV: and with their eyes , which go a whoring after their idols :

9.english_reference: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations .

traditions.WLC: וְ נָקֹ֨טּוּ֙ בִּ פְנֵי הֶ֔ם אֶל הָֽ רָעוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ לְ כֹ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֹתֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κόψονται πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς βδελύγμασιν αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: et displicébunt sibímet super malis quæ fecérunt in univérsis abominatiónibus suis .
traditions.KJV: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations .

10.english_reference: And they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Et scient quia ego Dóminus
traditions.KJV: And they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD , [ and that ]

10.english_reference: [ and that ] I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them .

traditions.WLC: לֹ֤א אֶל חִנָּם֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ הֶ֖ם הָ רָעָ֥ה הַ זֹּֽאת
traditions.VUL: non frustra locútus sum , ut fácerem eis malum hoc .
traditions.KJV: I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them .

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֗ה
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: הַכֵּ֨ה בְ כַפְּ ךָ֜
traditions.VUL: Pércute manum tuam ,
traditions.KJV: Smite with thine hand ,

traditions.WLC: וּ רְקַ֤ע בְּ רַגְלְ ךָ֙
traditions.VUL: et allíde pedem tuum ,
traditions.KJV: and stamp with thy foot ,

11.english_reference: and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel!

traditions.WLC: וֶֽ אֱמָר אָ֔ח אֶ֛ל כָּל תּוֹעֲב֥וֹת רָע֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰπόν Εὖγε εὖγε , ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς βδελύγμασιν οἴκου Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: et dic : Heu , ad omnes abominatiónes malórum domus Israel :
traditions.KJV: and say , Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel !

11.english_reference: for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֗ר בַּ חֶ֛רֶב בָּ רָעָ֥ב וּ בַ דֶּ֖בֶר יִפֹּֽלוּ
traditions.LXX: ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ πεσοῦνται .
traditions.VUL: quia gládio , fame , et peste ruitúri sunt .
traditions.KJV: for they shall fall by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence .

13.english_reference: Then shall ye know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Et sciétis quia ego Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Then shall ye know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

13.english_reference: when their slain [ men ] shall be among their idols round about their altars

traditions.WLC: בִּֽ הְי֣וֹת חַלְלֵי הֶ֗ם בְּ תוֹךְ֙ גִּלּ֣וּלֵי הֶ֔ם סְבִיב֖וֹת מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ εἶναι τοὺς τραυματίας ὑμῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν εἰδώλων ὑμῶν κύκλῳ τῶν θυσιαστηρίων ὑμῶν
traditions.VUL: cum fúerint interfécti vestri in médio idolórum vestrórum , in circúitu arárum vestrárum ,
traditions.KJV: when their slain [ men ] shall be among their idols round about their altars ,

traditions.WLC: אֶל֩ כָּל גִּבְעָ֨ה רָמָ֜ה
traditions.VUL: in omni colle excélso ,
traditions.KJV: upon every high hill ,

13.english_reference: in all the tops of the mountains

traditions.WLC: בְּ כֹ֣ל רָאשֵׁ֣י הֶ הָרִ֗ים
traditions.VUL: et in cunctis summitátibus móntium ,
traditions.KJV: in all the tops of the mountains ,

traditions.WLC: וְ תַ֨חַת כָּל עֵ֤ץ רַֽעֲנָן֙
traditions.VUL: et subtus omne lignum nemorósum ,
traditions.KJV: and under every green tree ,

traditions.WLC: וְ תַ֨חַת֙ כָּל אֵלָ֣ה עֲבֻתָּ֔ה
traditions.VUL: et subtus univérsam quercum frondósam ,
traditions.KJV: and under every thick oak ,

13.english_reference: the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols

traditions.WLC: מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ שָׁם֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ לְ כֹ֖ל גִּלּוּלֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: οὗ ἔδωκαν ἐκεῖ ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας πᾶσι τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: locum ubi accendérunt thura redoléntia univérsis idólis suis .
traditions.KJV: the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .

14.english_reference: So will I stretch out my hand upon them

traditions.WLC: וְ נָטִ֤יתִי אֶת יָדִ י֙ עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Et exténdam manum meam super eos :
traditions.KJV: So will I stretch out my hand upon them ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֨י אֶת הָ אָ֜רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֤ה וּ מְשַׁמָּה֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ θήσομαι τὴν γῆν εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ εἰς ὄλεθρον
traditions.VUL: et fáciam terram desolátam et destitútam ,
traditions.KJV: and make the land desolate ,

14.english_reference: yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath

traditions.WLC: מִ מִּדְבַּ֣ר דִּבְלָ֔תָ ה
traditions.VUL: a desérto Déblatha ,
traditions.KJV: yea , more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ כֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֽוֹתֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.VUL: in ómnibus habitatiónibus eórum :
traditions.KJV: in all their habitations :

14.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .
